executive_summary.current_position: PRODUCTION-GRADE RESEARCH PROTOTYPE FOR SINGLE-POINT PREDICTION; OFFLINE-ONLY FOR ARGO VALIDATION

subsurface_reference_target.interpolation: 1D linear interpolation from 50 native levels bounded within [0.494m, 1062.5m]; 0m extrapolated from 0.494m
subsurface_reference_target.regridding: Bilinear regridding from native 0.083° to target 0.25° grid
subsurface_reference_target.nature_of_target: Numerical reanalysis reference (NOT direct in-situ observational ground truth)

processed_dataset_inventory.valid_ocean_vs_land_masking: Strictly binary; channel 7 (mask_sst) indicates valid marine water cell (1.0) vs land/missing (0.0)

active_backend_model.projection_head: Conv2d(32, 15, kernel_size=1) with regional climatological stratification prior
active_backend_model.normalization: OceanStandardScaler loaded from configs/scaler_params_experiment_2020.json (fitted strictly on Jan-Jul 2020 train partition)
active_backend_model.lifecycle_loading: Loaded ONCE at FastAPI lifespan startup in singleton OceanEmbedInferenceService

argo_dedicated_audit.verdict_evidence: 1. backend/main.py contains exactly 5 endpoints (/, /health, /model-info, /available-dates, /predict); zero ARGO endpoints exist. 2. src/services/api.ts contains zero ARGO fetch methods. 3. ProfileChart.tsx plots only prediction.temperatures_c; no ARGO trace is overlaid. 4. ModelPerformance.tsx renders a static hardcoded array depthBreakdown with frozen metrics from offline evaluation reports.

endpoints.purpose: Health check, model loaded flag, device name
Model telemetry, parameters, input/output dimensions, domain coordinates
List supported observation dates from processed archive (274 days)
endpoints.data_source: In-memory date index from chunk_2020_01 to chunk_2020_09

endpoints.purpose: Reconstruct 15-depth vertical temperature profile from satellite inputs
endpoints.data_source: Processed monthly PyTorch tensor chunks + live model forward pass

features.caching_strategy: OrderedDict in-memory LRU cache storing up to 3 monthly chunks (~250MB RAM)
features.land_rejection: Returns HTTP 400 Bad Request if target grid cell has mask_sst <= 0.5
features.boundary_validation: Returns HTTP 400 Bad Request if latitude not in [5.0, 30.0] or longitude not in [45.0, 105.0]
features.date_validation: Returns HTTP 404 Not Found if date outside indexed 2020 archive

user_inputs.latitude_selection: Direct number input or map click (5.00°N to 30.00°N)
user_inputs.longitude_selection: Direct number input or map click (45.00°E to 105.00°E)
user_inputs.date_selection: HTML select populated dynamically via /available-dates API

dynamic_components.ProfileChart: Renders dynamic SVG temperature vs depth curve (0-1000m) from API response
dynamic_components.DepthInspector: 15 interactive pills displaying exact predicted temperature at each standard depth
dynamic_components.ProfileMetrics: Displays dynamically derived indicators: Surface, 100m, 500m, 1000m, MLD (0.2°C threshold), Thermocline depth (peak gradient), OHC300 (trapezoidal integration)
dynamic_components.SurfaceObservationsPanel: Displays 7 raw surface variables extracted at query grid cell (SST, SSS, SSH, U-current, V-current, U-wind, V-wind)

static_hardcoded_components.ModelPerformance: Hardcoded JSX values (0.8601°C, 0.7973°C, ~35.9 ms, and depthBreakdown array)
static_hardcoded_components.OceanMap: Custom SVG map with math-based coordinate projections (NOT Leaflet)

error_handling.on_land_error: Displays red alert in ControlPanel and clears stale prediction
error_handling.on_network_error: Displays connection error and resets prediction state

recommended_next_phase.title: PHASE 7: REAL INTERACTIVE ARGO IN-SITU VALIDATION SYSTEM
recommended_next_phase.rationale: All prerequisites (ARGO NetCDF files, verified collocation logic, OceanEmbed v3 model, FastAPI backend, React frontend) exist locally. Building an end-to-end interactive ARGO feature will bridge the single biggest gap in the project and eliminate static mock perceptions.

sub_phases.phase: PHASE A: ARGO Data Harmonization & Profile Indexing
sub_phases.objective: Build backend ingestion module to parse the 36 authentic September 2020 ARGO profiles from data/argo/argo2020/, cache them into a clean JSON/parquet catalog with WMO IDs, timestamps, coordinates, and 15-depth interpolated observed temperatures.

Expose dedicated endpoints: GET /argo/profiles (list all 36 floats with metadata) and GET /argo/compare/{profile_id} (returns observed ARGO profile vs OceanEmbed v3 prediction at exact float location/date with depth-wise absolute errors and summary RMSE).

sub_phases.phase: PHASE C: Frontend Interactive Float Map & Comparison Chart
sub_phases.objective: Add an 'ARGO In-Situ Validation' mode to the UI: render real float pins on the ocean map, allow clicking a float pin, and plot dual curves (ARGO Observed vs OceanEmbed Predicted) in ProfileChart with dynamic RMSE/MAE telemetry.

sub_phases.phase: PHASE D: End-to-End Validation & Automated Testing
sub_phases.objective: Add automated pytest integration tests verifying that float comparison returns identical 0.7973°C basin benchmark across the 497 points and that all 36 profiles resolve cleanly.
